What is the average track length per media type, in minutes?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0,2) AS avg_minutes, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds),2) AS avg_milliseconds, COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY m.MediaTypeId;"}

sql_used:
SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0,2) AS avg_minutes, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds),2) AS avg_milliseconds, COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY m.MediaTypeId;
assumptions: Track.Milliseconds represents track duration and is converted to minutes by dividing by 60000.
Average is the simple mean across tracks for each media type.
Tracks without a media type are excluded by the join (no such tracks expected).
